battle.name: 維京人突襲葡萄牙
battle.brief: 844年，一支北歐維京船隊溯瓜達基維爾河攻入安達盧斯，圍攻塞維爾四十四天，因守軍木製火龍裝置而退兵，繼而攻陷北非休達與塔霍河口的里斯本，縱掠而歸，最終在海上遭遇暴風，艦隊散盡。卡面秦連弩代表守城方以連發弩機壓制攻城者的器械邏輯，而伊比利亞守軍當時只有土製火攻與投石機。

kit.name: 秦連弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，一踩一發。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 這場戰爭的雙方是北歐斯堪的納維亞的維京戰士船隊，與控制伊比利亞半島南部的安達盧斯政權。維京方並非國家，而是一支以數十艘長船組成、沒有後方與基地的武裝船團，戰士多來自今日挪威西南部與丹麥的島嶼海岸，頭領姓名在 844 年的阿拉伯文獻中完全沒有留下；船隊的補給完全靠沿途劫掠與登岸取糧，屬於典型的海掠型戰役。對手方是科爾多瓦埃米爾國，執政者阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼二世，此時安達盧斯的領土自科爾多瓦延伸到接近今葡萄牙的邊境，境內由穆斯林、基督徒與基什瓦茲亞人分割共治，並不牢固。直接被捲入戰鬥的是三處城鎮：塞維爾（阿拉伯語作伊什比利耶）、位於海峽對岸的休達，以及塔霍河口的里斯本；三城各有總督、市議會與民兵，但常備兵力有限，一旦遭遇數十艘船的登陸者便難以應付。值得注意的是，同一時期的基督教西班牙並非袖手旁觀：阿斯圖里亞斯與加利西亞一帶的諸侯在西北岸同樣承受北歐人的掠奪，阿拉伯文獻記載北方的基督徒軍隊曾趁維京人返程時打劫其戰利品，說明這場衝突自始就是多方在伊比利亞周邊互相窺伺的一環，而非單向的遠征。
countriesEn: The two sides in this war were a Viking war-band of Scandinavian longships and the Andalusi government that controlled the southern Iberian peninsula. The Viking side was not a state at all but an armed flotilla of several dozen longships, with no rear area and no base of its own; the crews were drawn mostly from the coasts of what are now south-west Norway and the Danish islands, and no name, title or rank of any Viking leader survives in the Arabic accounts of 844. Their supply was taken entirely by raiding along the coast and by fetching food and water from the shore, which makes this a textbook sea-raiding campaign. Their opponent was the Emirate of Córdoba under Abd al-Rahman II, whose dominions ran from Córdoba to the neighbourhood of the present Portuguese border and were shared, insecurely, among Muslims, Christians and the Slavic communities of the north-west. Three settlements were drawn directly into the fighting: Seville (Ishbiliya in Arabic), Ceuta across the strait, and Lisbon (Lishbuna) at the mouth of the Tagus; each had its own wali, council and militia, but standing forces were thin, and nothing could hold a landing of several dozen ships. Christian Iberia was not a bystander either: the princes of Asturias and Galicia on the north-west coast were themselves being raided by Northmen, and the Arabic chronicles record a Christian force from the north trying to fall on the Vikings' plunder as they made their way home, which shows that this campaign was one triangle of a wider contest for the waters around Iberia rather than a one-way raid.
people: 維京方的首領在當時的史料中查無實名，這本身就是這場戰爭最值得記錄的一點。留下記述的阿拉伯史家伊本·伊德哈里與伊本·哈茲蒙都只寫「北方人」的船隊，沒有記下任何一位維京首領的名字、封號或身量。安達盧斯方面可追到埃米爾阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼二世（822 至 851 年在位）治下的邊防體系；圍城期間做出關鍵決策的是塞維爾的總督與市民代表，以及提出並執行「火龍」之策的那批工匠與教士。據伊本·哈茲蒙記載，人們把一具木製獸首裝在塔架上，由其口中噴出火焰與濃煙，維京人把它當成活獸，攻城因而瓦解，這條細節是後世所有關於火龍的敘述的源頭。兩位敘述者本身也是關鍵人物：伊本·伊德哈里在《西遷記》保存了 844 年的編年框架，伊本·哈茲蒙的《真實與傳奇》保存了圍城日數與火龍的細節，近代以來所有對這場戰爭的追問都繞不開他們的文本。進入近代之後，葡萄牙地方傳統把一位名叫達莫迪斯的維京首領與奧拉夫的名字寫進聖托卡托受洗的傳說，那是十二世紀以後層層累積的編年史與聖徒傳說，不屬於 844 年的記錄；本文只把它當作後世記憶的產物，不當作史實。
peopleEn: The Viking commander is simply unrecorded, and that absence is itself one of the most important facts about this war. Both of the Arabic chroniclers who narrate it, Ibn Idhari and Ibn Hazhun, refer only to a fleet of 'people from the north' and give no name, no title and no description of the man who led it. On the Andalusi side the action can be placed inside the frontier administration of the emir Abd al-Rahman II (r. 822-851): the decisions that mattered during the siege were taken by the wali of Seville together with the city's community representatives, and by the craftsmen and clergy who proposed and then executed the 'dragon' stratagem. According to Ibn Hazhun, a wooden animal head was mounted on a scaffold and breathed out fire and smoke; the Vikings took it for a living beast, the siege broke, and that single detail is the source of every later telling of the fire-breathing head. The two chroniclers are themselves central figures: Ibn Idhari's al-Bayan al-Mughrib preserves the annalistic frame of 844, while Ibn Hazhun's al-Haqiqa wa'l-Majaz preserves the length of the siege and the details of the device, and every modern question about this campaign runs through their text. In later centuries Portuguese local tradition gave a Viking leader the name Dâmodis and the name Olavo and tied them to a baptism at São Torcato; that belongs to layers of chronicle and hagiography written long after 844, and is treated here as a product of later memory rather than as history.
kits: 卡面兵器是中國的秦連弩，即以機械連發的弩機，約成形於公元前 3 世紀的戰國弩工。把它放進這場戰爭，說明的是它所代表的整個器械類別：弩機把弦的拉力先存進機身，踩下踏桿即發一矢，無需反覆張弦；守方只要備足矢匣與替換件，就能以接近連續的節奏把射界內的進攻者壓在牆外。在 844 年的伊比利亞，這一類器械並不存在。塞維爾與里斯本的守軍用的是另一套木製扭力與投擲式攻城武器：手擲的小型螺栓投射器、固定安裝在城頭的弩，以及靠人力絞索發射石彈的投石機，安達盧斯守軍還有從薩拉科薩一帶調來的老舊攻城器。真正改變局面的並不是任何一種投射器，而是伊本·哈茲蒙所記的木製火龍裝置與火攻，這說明中世紀守城方對攻城方的技術壓制仍以土法與心理戰為主。進攻的維京人同樣缺乏攻城器械：他們沒有投石機、沒有衝撞車、也沒有可用的弩機，只有斧、矛、圓盾、鎖子甲與長船；能攻下里斯本，靠的是船數、登岸的速度與當地守軍的薄弱，而不是器械上的優勢。中國方面，同一時期的唐代軍器中已有床弩與弩機一類，《三國志·諸葛亮傳》所記諸葛亮「損益連弩」那套機械理論，在九世紀並不落後於歐洲；只是這條技術路線從未越過中亞進入地中海，兩套體系在同一場戰爭裡毫無交集。
kitsEn: The card's weapon is the Chinese Qin repeating crossbow, a mechanical multi-shot crossbow that took shape around the third century BC among the crossbow craftsmen of the Warring States. Placed in this war it stands for a whole class of machine rather than for a specific piece: the tension of the string is stored in the body of the machine, the tread is pressed and a single bolt is loosed, so the bow is never drawn by hand again, and a defender with a full magazine of bolts and spare parts can keep a near-continuous rate of fire on everything crossing the killing ground. In Iberia in 844 that class of machine did not exist. The garrisons of Seville and Lisbon used a different set of wooden torsion and throwing engines: small hand-thrown bolt-throwers, fixed crossbows mounted on the wall, and stone-throwing engines worked by rope and manpower, together with older siege machines sent north from the Saragossa region. What actually turned the balance was not any projectile weapon but the wooden dragon and fire-attack device recorded by Ibn Hazhun, which shows that medieval siege defence still rested largely on improvised engineering and psychological warfare. The attacking Vikings were no better served: they had no trebuchet, no battering ram and no repeating crossbow of their own, only axes, spears, round shields, mail and their longships. Their capture of Lisbon rested on numbers, on the speed of the landing and on a thin garrison, not on any technical superiority in artillery. On the Chinese side, Tang-era armouries already held bed crossbows and mounted crossbow machines, and the mechanical tradition behind the repeating crossbow was by the ninth century no slower than anything in Europe; that line of development simply never crossed Central Asia into the Mediterranean, and the two systems had no contact whatever in this war.
tactics: 維京船隊的戰術核心是海岸登陸與連續劫掠。從海峽進入後，他們先在阿爾加夫一帶的海岸地帶掃蕩，取糧、徵用牲畜、補充淡水，再溯瓜達基維爾河深入安達盧斯腹地，因為該河是當地最便捷的內陸航道。下一步是攻塞維爾：先打掉城郊的莊園、果園與教堂，把無法遷走的居民趕回城內，再以封鎖代替強攻，把圍城變成對城郊的系統性剝削。阿拉伯文獻稱圍城持續四十四天，其間維京人試圖以火攻與夜襲消耗守軍，最終因火龍裝置而退兵。維京人接著轉向馬格里布，突擊休達這一個前線小堡，憑突然性速戰速決，奪城後停留數日便再上路；最後才移兵塔霍河口，圍攻里斯本，奪城後縱情劫掠，市場與教會的財物被搬上船。整條戰線的補給不靠後方基地，靠的是船隊本身：長船既是交通工具、又是移動的營房、又是撤退的憑依，糧食飲水靠登岸取得或以劫掠補足。海路補給的弱點在最後暴露：艦隊離開里斯本後在海上遇到暴風，損失慘重，倖存者寥寥。守方的戰術則是典型的九世紀城防：利用城牆高度與城郊緩衝區拖住敵人，以民兵輪換守段，關鍵時刻以火攻與心理手段打亂敵方士氣。
tacticsEn: The Viking tactics rested on coastal landing and continuous plunder. Having entered through the strait, they first swept the coast of the Algarve, taking food, livestock and fresh water, and then went up the Guadalquivir, the most convenient inland waterway the region had, because the river was the easiest road into Andalusian territory. The next step was Seville: first to destroy the orchards, farms and churches of the outskirts, to drive back into the city the population who could not move, and then to substitute blockade for assault, turning the siege into a systematic stripping of the countryside. The Arabic accounts give the siege as forty-four days; during it the Vikings tried fire and night attacks to wear the garrison down, and finally withdrew in face of the fire-breathing device. They then turned south to the Maghreb and struck Ceuta, a small frontier post, winning it by suddenness and speed, remaining a few days and then moving on; only afterwards did they march on the Tagus and besiege Lisbon, taking the city and stripping its markets, churches and houses onto their ships. Supply for the whole line came not from any base but from the fleet itself: a longship was at once transport, mobile barracks and the guarantee of retreat, and grain and water were fetched ashore or taken by force. The weakness of supply by sea showed at the end: after leaving Lisbon the fleet met a storm and was scattered, with very few survivors. The defence followed the normal pattern of a ninth-century walled town, using wall height and the cleared outskirts as a buffer, rotating the militia through the sections of the circuit, and at the decisive moment breaking the attackers' nerve with fire and terror.
data: 可核的數字不多，能確定的有幾項。圍攻塞維爾的日數，阿拉伯文獻明載四十四天，這是本場戰爭最可靠的一個數字。艦隊規模沒有確數，兩位敘述者都只說「數十艘」乃至「大軍」，不宜具體化，近代研究一般以「數十艘以上」概括，而不引用任何精確船數。距離方面，瓜達基維爾河口到塞維爾約一百公里，屬順流直上的內河航道；塞維爾到里斯本沿海岸折行約三百公里；休達則在海峽對岸，橫渡約一百三十公里。時間上，這一串行動在 844 年之內完成：圍塞維爾、陷休達、陷里斯本，加上最後的航行與風暴，歷時在數月之間。損失方面，史料只說休達與里斯本遭到劫掠與焚燒，沒有可靠的傷亡數目；風暴之後艦隊幾乎全毀、倖存者寥寥，這一點可以確定，但沒有具體人數。九年之後的 859 年，維京人再以四十艘船進犯阿爾加夫，據伊本·伊德哈里記載，安達盧斯出動的艦隊約二百艘，卻在交戰前被暴風摧毀大半，殘部接戰之後，維京人奪走七艘穆斯林戰船，穆斯林一方亦奪維京船四艘——這是整段序列裡少數帶確數的一條，也是 844 年最直接的後續。
dataEn: Reliable numbers are scarce, but a few can be fixed. The length of the siege of Seville is given explicitly in the Arabic sources as forty-four days, and that is the most trustworthy figure this war yields. The size of the fleet is not recorded in any number: both chroniclers speak only of a score of ships, or of a great host, and it should not be turned into a precise count; modern work generally says 'several dozen or more' and quotes no exact figure. Distances are more tractable. It is about a hundred kilometres from the mouth of the Guadalquivir to Seville, all of it open river; from Seville to Lisbon the coastal run is roughly three hundred kilometres; and Ceuta lies across the strait, about a hundred and thirty kilometres of open water. The whole sequence — the siege of Seville, the fall of Ceuta, the fall of Lisbon, and the final passage home — was completed within 844, over a period of months rather than weeks. On losses the sources record only that Ceuta and Lisbon were plundered and their houses burned; no casualty figure is reliable. That the fleet was afterwards almost entirely destroyed, and that very few men survived the storm, is certain in outline but carries no number. Nine years later, in 859, the Vikings came back with forty ships; according to Ibn Idhari the Andalusi fleet numbered about two hundred, but a storm destroyed most of it before the fleets engaged, and in the action that followed the Vikings took seven Muslim ships while the Muslims took four Viking vessels — the closest thing to a numbered record in the whole sequence, and the direct sequel to 844.
cause: 維京人出現在伊比利亞不是偶發事件，而是北歐海掠體系向西南擴張的結果。八世紀末到九世紀初，維京人靠快船、輕裝與對水道的善用，完成了從劫掠英格蘭海岸到劫掠法蘭克海岸的西進；839 年前後法蘭克王國在宮廷內部的衝突中崩解，沿海的設防與巡邏一度鬆散，緬因貝格王國的劫掠更把整片北海推入戰爭狀態。科爾多瓦埃米爾國在 844 年的處境並不理想：帝國中部被內戰與地方叛亂拖住，總督與邊區軍團各自為政，南方海岸線綿長，港口缺乏深水防禦。這種真空對船隊的吸引力是顯而易見的：安達盧斯富庶，黃金、白銀、椰棗與絲織物密集，卻不像北方那樣有縱深可擾。促成行動的還有一條更長的因果鏈：711 年以後穆斯林在伊比利亞建立政權，把大量基督徒農民壓在土地上，這些社群在戰亂中屢次被捲入，既缺乏可靠的防禦，也不願與攻擊者合作，令每次登陸都變得容易。另一個常被忽略的動力是航海季節：北歐人到地中海不過是一段順風航程，而季風與洋流在夏末提供回程的窗口，於是戰役季節被牢牢鎖在春末到初秋。
causeEn: The Viking appearance in Iberia was not an accident but the result of the North Atlantic raiding system expanding to the south-west. From the late eighth century the fast ship, the light load and the decisive use of inland waterways had carried Scandinavian raiding from the English coast to the Frankish coast; the collapse of Frankish kingship in the struggles of the 830s and 840s left coastal defence and coastal patrol thin and intermittent, and the sack of the West Frankish kingdom pushed the whole North Sea into a state of war. The Emirate of Córdoba was in poor condition in 844: the centre of the empire was absorbed in civil war and provincial revolt, the wali and the frontier corps acted on their own, and the long southern coastline offered deep-water harbours without adequate defences. The attraction of such a vacuum to a fleet is obvious: al-Andalus was rich in coin, silver, dates and woven silk, and offered no depth of country to be harried as the north did. A longer causal chain also lies behind the campaign. After 711 the Muslim government in Iberia had settled a large Christian peasantry on the land in a position of subordination, and these communities, chronically insecure and only loosely supervised, were repeatedly drawn into war; a half-autonomous frontier society that would not cooperate with the attackers made every landing that much easier. A less discussed motive is the calendar itself: for the Northmen the Mediterranean was one favourable passage, and the winds and currents of late summer gave them a window home, which fixed the campaigning season between late spring and early autumn.
impact: 直接影響有三層。第一層在戰術層面：塞維爾沒有陷落，說明一座中等規模的城牆加上一件有效的火攻裝置，就能抵擋一支規模不小的北歐船隊；但休達與里斯本接連失守，又說明當時安達盧斯的邊防體系經不起持續壓力。結果是九年後的第二次進犯，規模更大，雙方才真正打了一場海戰，也才第一次出現艦隊對艦隊的消耗戰，而不是單方面的登岸劫掠。第二層在海上力量的意義上，844 年是維京人作為一支能遠征西地中海的力量被記錄下來的最早一批事件之一，它把「維京只是海盜」的說法推遠了，此後學界討論北歐遠征，總會把 844 年與後來的西西里、君士坦丁堡並列。第三層在記憶與地誌上最為持久：葡萄牙與加利西亞的地方傳統把 844 年之後的北歐人殘蹤寫進聖地與地景——聖托卡托的受洗傳說、聖西普里安的「獨眼巨人」石像被說成維京婦女化石的版本，以及「巨人石斧」「巨人女」一類地名，都在回憶 844 年之後沒有一支船隊回得了家的事實。不過這層記憶與史料並不吻合，它在幾百年間被教會、王室與地方編年史反覆加工，所講的更多是皈依與定居，而不是劫掠與屠城。第四層在兵器史上是反向的提醒：這場戰爭裡雙方都沒有投射型攻城器械，勝負竟然由一件木製火龍裝置決定，說明九世紀的攻城戰仍大量依賴工藝奇計，而不是火力的密度。
impactEn: The consequences run on several levels. At the tactical level Seville did not fall, which shows that a walled town of middling size, combined with one effective fire device, could hold a Viking fleet of no small size; but the successive loss of Ceuta and Lisbon shows that the Andalusi frontier system could not withstand sustained pressure. The result was a second invasion nine years later, larger than the first, and the first time the two sides fought a real battle of fleets rather than a series of unopposed landings and plunderings. At the level of maritime power, 844 belongs to the earliest clearly recorded instances of a Scandinavian force operating in the western Mediterranean; it pushed back the idea that the Vikings were merely pirates, and since then the great Norse expeditions have usually been discussed alongside 844 and the later sieges of Sicily and Constantinople. At the level of memory and topography the trace is most durable. Portuguese and Galician local tradition folded the aftermath of 844 into its holy places and its landscape: the baptism legend of São Torcato, the Cyclops statues of Saint Cyprian in Galicia presented as petrified Viking women, and place-names of the Giant's Axe and the Giant Women all preserve the memory that not one ship of that fleet ever came home. That memory, however, does not match the sources: over the centuries it was reworked by the Church, the crown and local chroniclers, and what it finally tells is a story of conversion and settlement rather than of plunder and killing. Finally, the arms history of the campaign points the other way. Neither side had any projectile siege engine, and the outcome was decided by a wooden fire-breathing device, which shows how much of ninth-century siege warfare still rested on craft tricks rather than on the weight of fire.
result: 結局是三段式的：塞維爾沒拿下，休達與里斯本被掃平，艦隊在海上被風暴吃掉。圍攻塞維爾四十四天後，維京人因火龍裝置與火攻的震撼而解圍北去；北非的休達被迅速攻陷，遭劫掠與屠殺；隨後兵鋒轉向塔霍河口，里斯本在短暫圍攻後淪陷，市場、教會與民居的財物被搬上船。得手的維京人並沒有在半島上建立據點，沒有留下駐軍，也沒有留下任何行政安排，他們只是把船隊重新駛回海峽。這條航線沒有讓他們回家：離開里斯本之後的航行中遇到暴風，艦隊在伊比利亞外海與比斯開灣一帶散盡，船只盡毀，倖存者被風吹散到岸上，有的淪為俘虜，有的漂到愛爾蘭一帶，從此消失在記錄裡。對安達盧斯而言，這是一場代價高昂的邊境戰：南方城鎮遭受破壞，而真正的損失是整支北歐艦隊沒有機會再回到直布羅陀海峽——這也讓 859 年的再犯顯得並不尋常。就維京史而言，844 年是一次典型的「遠征得手而返航失敗」的戰役：戰利品在手，航路卻斷了。
resultEn: The outcome came in three parts: Seville was not taken, Ceuta and Lisbon were swept, and the fleet was eaten by the sea. After forty-four days before Seville the Vikings broke off in the face of the fire-breathing device and moved north; Ceuta was taken quickly, plundered and sacked; the army then swung to the Tagus and Lisbon fell after a short siege, with the wealth of its markets, churches and houses loaded onto the ships. The victors left no garrison, no fortified base and no administrative arrangement on the peninsula; they simply put the fleet back to sea. That passage did not bring them home. In the sailing that followed the departure from Lisbon a storm struck, the fleet scattered in the waters off Iberia and in the Bay of Biscay, the ships were lost, and the survivors were driven ashore, some taken captive and some blown towards Ireland, where they vanish from the record. For al-Andalus this was an expensive frontier war: the southern towns had been wrecked, and the true loss was that the whole North European fleet had no opportunity to come back to the Strait of Gibraltar, which makes the return of 859 all the more remarkable. In Viking history 844 is a textbook case of a successful raid destroyed by a failed homeward passage: the plunder was theirs, the sea was not.
